lint.description: Lint the crates with cargo fmt and cargo clippy.

docs-links.description: Check every relative link and anchor in the project's README.md files and doc/ trees; a broken one fails lint.

test.description: Test the crates with cargo-nextest and cargo-llvm-cov, and read their JUnit and LCOV reports.
Test filter to run, passed to nextest as -E 'test(~<filter>)', which selects the tests whose name contains it; a crate where it selects none passes

run.description: Build a binary crate for the host with cargo run, run it once, and forward its exit code.

port.description: Port (set via the PORT environment variable)

entrypoint.description: Binary of the crate to run (defaults to its default-run or only binary)

serve.description: Serve a binary crate with cargo run and PORT set, until the user stops it.

port.description: Port (set via the PORT environment variable); 0 selects a free port

entrypoint.description: Binary of the crate to serve (defaults to its default-run or only binary)

build.description: Build the crates with cargo build.

package.description: Package the binary of a crate: platform archives, an OCI image, a staged crate.

docker.description: Assemble an OCI image, with no docker daemon

platforms.description: Archive platforms: all, or a comma-separated list (linux/amd64,darwin/arm64). Defaults to the five archive platforms

port.description: Port the image exposes and sets as PORT

entrypoint.description: Binary of the crate to package (defaults to its default-run or only binary)

dry-run.description: Plan the archives and the image without building them; the crate is still staged

docker-base-image.description: Override the digest-pinned base image (must include @sha256:... for reproducible digests)

docker-load.description: Also load the assembled image into the local docker daemon

crates.description: Stage the crate at the release version, leaving the checkout untouched

publish.description: Publish the crate to a registry and push the image of the package step.

crates.description: Publish the staged crate with cargo publish

crates-registry.description: Name of the Cargo registry, as cargo publish --registry takes it

workspace-fetch.description: Download the crates and git dependencies each stack root's Cargo.lock names into cargo's home with cargo fetch --locked, running none of their code.

workspace-install.description: Fetch the dependencies of each stack root of the workspace with cargo fetch, and install the test tools.

force.description: Fetch a stack root even when cargo's home holds every crate its Cargo.lock names

deps-upgrade.description: Update the Cargo.lock of each stack root of the workspace with cargo update.

workspace-fetch-exec.description: Run cargo fetch --locked at each stack root of the workspace that holds a Cargo.lock, with no rustc wrapper and no rustc the repository's Cargo configuration names, which downloads the locked crates and git dependencies into cargo's home, builds nothing and writes nothing in the repository. A stack root with no Cargo.lock is left out with a warning.

workspace-install-exec.description: Run cargo fetch at each stack root of the workspace, which writes a missing Cargo.lock, except the projects disable.tags excludes and the roots whose locked crates cargo's home already holds, unless the force flag is set; then install cargo-nextest and cargo-llvm-cov when the PATH holds neither. Offline, it runs cargo fetch --locked --offline, which checks each Cargo.lock against cargo's home and writes nothing.

deps-upgrade-exec.description: Run cargo update at each stack root of the workspace with the cargo the toolchain check selects, which moves each locked version to the newest one its semver requirement accepts.

lint-docs.description: Documentation link check: every relative link and anchor in the project's README.md files and doc/ trees must resolve, with the exact case of the file's name. The task body is the SDK's docslinks.Job, shared with every language extension. A link may name any file of the workspace, so the check reads the workspace's Git candidate cut (the tracked files and the untracked files no ignore rule excludes) and its key is the workspace input `git:**`, which holds that cut: deleting or renaming a link target, or editing a heading an anchor names, moves the key, and an ignored file is neither read nor keyed. The project input names the README.md the check starts from, so the key does not fold the project's ignored build output. Outside a Git work tree the check reads the disk and the task has no key. It needs no Rust toolchain.

run-exec.description: Run the crate's binary once with cargo run, after the toolchain check, and forward its exit code. It declares no output: a run produces only the program's exit status and streams.

serve-run.description: Serve the crate's binary with cargo run and PORT set, after the toolchain check, and announce it ready once its port accepts connections. It declares no output: a cache hit cannot reproduce a live process.

lint-run.description: Run the Rust profile's lint steps, cargo fmt --check then cargo clippy, on one crate in its directory, after the toolchain check. Its inputs are the files the rust:lint selector answers from the resolved profile, and the stack-root files of the profile.

data.description: The task result: the test and coverage totals of a test task.

reports.description: The reports the task wrote or copied: the LCOV report and a copy of each JUnit report of a test task.

test-run.description: Run the Rust profile's test steps, cargo llvm-cov nextest, on one crate in its directory, after the toolchain check, with the test flag passed to nextest as a filterset and --no-tests=pass; then copy the nextest JUnit report and the LCOV report into the command output and read them. A failed case, a step that exits non-zero, or a missing report fails the task.

data.description: The task result: the test and coverage totals of a test task.

reports.description: The reports the task wrote or copied: the LCOV report and a copy of each JUnit report of a test task.

build-run.description: Run the Rust profile's build step, cargo build --locked, on one crate in its directory, after the toolchain check; then copy the crate's binary from the stack root's target/debug into the command output when cargo wrote one there.

data.description: The task result: the test and coverage totals of a test task.

reports.description: The artifacts the build task copied: the crate's binary, when cargo wrote one in the stack root's target/debug.

package-compile.description: Compile the crate's binary in release mode with cargo zigbuild for each platform the package channels need, under the stack root's lock, and copy it to bin/<platform-suffix>/ in the command output. A Linux binary links against glibc 2.36. Installs Rust, zig, cargo-zigbuild and the Rust targets in the Putnami home.

bin.description: The binary of each platform at bin/<platform-suffix>/<name>. Sole owner of <command-output>/bin. Empty for a library.

package-archives.description: Write one reproducible tar.gz per platform with the binary at its root, the archive channel record and the publication manifest. Reads the bin tree package-compile owns.

archives.description: Per-platform .tar.gz archives and the archive channel record. Sole owner of <command-output>/archives.

publication-manifest.description: Archive publication manifest read by the archive uploader. Sole owner of <command-output>/metadata.json.

package-docker.description: Assemble a reproducible OCI layout for one Linux platform with no docker daemon, the manifest the shared Docker publisher reads and the docker channel record. Reads the bin tree package-compile owns, and pulls the base image.

docker.description: Local OCI layout, manifest and docker channel record. Sole owner of <command-output>/docker.

package-crate.description: Copy the stack root without its build output to crates/workspace in the command output, write the release version into each manifest and each normal path dependency, and refresh the copy's lockfile. The checkout stays untouched.

crates.description: The staged copy of the stack root and the crates channel record. Sole owner of <command-output>/crates.

publish-crates.description: Run cargo publish from the staged copy. A version the registry already holds is reused. Dry run uploads nothing.

publish-docker.description: Push the assembled image with the shared Docker publisher. Declares the registry effect.

published-image.description: Publish-owned verified remote image record, present only after registry digest verification.
